finalText:
**Migration done.** I moved 36 calls in 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. It has 2 old calls. Its own comment says edits there get wiped on every upgrade. That one needs a fix upstream instead.

One thing that looked like a match but isn't: `cache.query` in 20 files. That takes a cache key, not SQL. Different thing, untouched.

All 75 files parse. I ran every exported function against a stub database. 325 calls, all the new form.
